title: Promote qualified metadata under explicit rules
objective: Supported literal metadata can scale while high-impact uncertainty remains reviewable.
outcome: Validated literal publisher metadata can promote under an approved field/source rule. Inferred scientific statements, identity merges and ambiguous mappings cannot receive literal-observation status. Stale approvals, incomplete source runs and changed field hashes cannot promote. Unaffected accepted claims remain available. Rollback restores prior public facts and retains newer attempt/review history. Scientific and technical acceptance are separate. Automated rules cannot authorize source access or legal rights. Sealed packages/normalization/src and packages/identity/src/review-ledger.mjs are not edited.

commits.subject: Define promotion classes
commits.instructions: Allow validated literal publisher metadata under an approved field/source rule; require explicit review for high-impact scientific interpretations, identity merges and ambiguous mappings. Record the policy version.
commits.verification: Not every literal field needs a separate human click, but no inferred scientific statement receives literal-observation status.

commits.subject: Apply exact accepted claim revisions
commits.instructions: Build a candidate revision using source/generation/value hashes and individual dispositions. Keep rejected/conflicting/unknown values and their provenance intact.
commits.verification: A stale approval, incomplete source run or changed field hash cannot promote; unaffected accepted claims remain available.

commits.subject: Produce reversible promotion diffs
commits.instructions: Output before/after source-card/schema/example changes plus dependent search/API effects. Support returning to the previous accepted generation without destructive data migration.
commits.verification: Rollback restores prior public facts and retains the newer attempt/review history for diagnosis.
